sourceNote: Curated educational mapping. Lesson pages: ESLSongs.com. Audio: YouTube (external). No scraping at runtime.

songs.title: Just the Way You Are
songs.whyHelps: This song repeats many Present Simple forms. Hearing the -s ending in a natural melody makes the pattern stick.
songs.whyHelpsFa: این آهنگ بارها ساختار حال ساده را تکرار می‌کند. شنیدن پایانه‌ی s در ملودی به ماندگاری الگو کمک می‌کند.
examples: She's so beautiful, and I tell her every day.
When I see your face, there's not a thing that I would change.

quiz.promptEn: When she ____ me if she looks OK, I always say yes. (ask)
quiz.promptFa: When she ____ me if she looks OK… (ask)
quiz.hintFa: she در حال ساده با s می‌آید

quiz.hintEn: he/she/it negative → does not / doesn't + base verb

quiz.promptFa: فقط جملهٔ درست را پیدا کن:
options: She look amazing just the way she are
She looks amazing just the way she is
She looking amazing just the way she is
She looks amazing just the way she are
quiz.answer: She looks amazing just the way she is
quiz.hintFa: looks برای she و is برای she

quiz.promptEn: Which question is correct Present Simple?
quiz.promptFa: کدام سوال حال ساده درست است؟
quiz.hintEn: Does + she + base verb (look, not looks)
quiz.hintFa: Does + she + فعل ساده (look نه looks)

quiz.promptEn: The whole world ____ and stares for a while. (stop)
Rewrite correctly: "Her laugh she hate but I think it sexy."
quiz.promptFa: درست‌نویسی: "Her laugh she hate but I think it sexy."
options: She hate her laugh but I thinks it is sexy.
She hates her laugh but I think it is sexy.
She hates her laugh but I thinks it is sexy.
She hate her laugh but I think it sexy.
quiz.answer: She hates her laugh but I think it is sexy.
quiz.hintEn: she hates / I think (no -s on think)
quiz.hintFa: she hates — اما I think بدون s

songs.title: Wonderful Tonight
songs.grammarFocusFa: حال ساده — مثبت، منفی و سوالی
songs.whyHelps: The lyrics mix statements and questions in Present Simple (she puts on, Do I look…?). Good for noticing question form with do.
songs.whyHelpsFa: متن هم جمله خبری و هم سوال حال ساده دارد؛ برای دیدن فرم سوالی با do مناسب است.
examples: She puts on her make-up and brushes her long blonde hair.
And then she asks me, "Do I look all right?"

quiz.promptEn: It's late; she ____ what clothes to wear. (wonder)
quiz.promptFa: It's late; she ____ what clothes to wear. (wonder)
quiz.hintFa: در روایت حال ساده: she wonders

quiz.promptEn: She puts on her make-up and ____ her hair. (brush)
quiz.promptFa: She puts on… and ____ her hair. (brush)

quiz.promptEn: Correct the question: "Does I look all right?"
quiz.promptFa: سوال را درست کن: "Does I look all right?"
quiz.hintFa: با I از Do استفاده می‌شود نه Does

quiz.promptEn: Everyone ____ to see this beautiful lady. (turn)

options: You just don't realizes how much I love you.
You just doesn't realize how much I love you.
You just don't realize how much I love you.
You just not realize how much I love you.
quiz.answer: You just don't realize how much I love you.

quiz.promptEn: Pick the sentence with a Present Simple ERROR:
quiz.promptFa: جمله‌ای که خطا دارد را پیدا کن:
options: We go to a party and everyone turns to see.
She asks me and I say yes.
She put on her make-up every evening.
quiz.answer: She put on her make-up every evening.
quiz.hintFa: عادت در حال → puts نه put
